sentences.pt: Letícia tinha quinze anos quando os pais pediram o divórcio.
sentences.en: Letícia was fifteen when her parents filed for divorce.

sentences.pt: Ela continuou morando com o pai em Belo Horizonte, e a mãe se mudou para Recife.
sentences.en: She kept living with her father in Belo Horizonte, and her mother moved to Recife.

sentences.pt: Um ano depois, o pai contou que tinha uma namorada, Juliana, uma enfermeira simpática e generosa.
sentences.en: A year later, her father said he had a girlfriend, Juliana, a friendly and generous nurse.

sentences.pt: Quando eles se casaram, Juliana veio morar no apartamento com o filho dela, Thiago, de oito anos.
sentences.en: When they got married, Juliana came to live in the apartment with her son, Thiago, who was eight.

sentences.pt: Para Letícia, a convivência com a madrasta e o enteado do pai era muito difícil.
sentences.en: For Letícia, living with her stepmother and her father's stepson was very hard.

sentences.pt: Ela achava Thiago mimado e barulhento, e Juliana, uma desconhecida que mandava na casa dela.
sentences.en: She thought Thiago was spoiled and noisy, and Juliana a stranger who was bossing her house around.

sentences.pt: Para as amigas, ela dizia que detestava a família nova do pai.
sentences.en: To her friends, she said that she hated her father's new family.

sentences.pt: Por isso, quase não falava com eles e passava as tardes sozinha no quarto.
sentences.en: So she hardly spoke to them and spent the afternoons alone in her room.

sentences.pt: Juliana tentava conversar, mas Letícia era teimosa e respondia sempre com uma palavra só.
sentences.en: Juliana tried to talk, but Letícia was stubborn and always answered with just one word.

sentences.pt: Numa noite de inverno, o pai estava viajando a trabalho, e Letícia acordou com muita febre e dor de garganta.
sentences.en: One winter night, her father was away on a work trip, and Letícia woke up with a high fever and a sore throat.

sentences.pt: Ela não queria pedir ajuda, mas estava tão mal que não conseguia nem se levantar.
sentences.en: She didn't want to ask for help, but she felt so bad that she couldn't even get up.

sentences.pt: Thiago ouviu a tosse dela e foi correndo chamar a mãe.
sentences.en: Thiago heard her coughing and ran to call his mother.

sentences.pt: Juliana mediu a temperatura, deu um remédio e passou a madrugada inteira ao lado da cama.
sentences.en: Juliana took her temperature, gave her medicine and spent the whole night beside the bed.

sentences.pt: De manhã, levou Letícia ao médico, que disse que era uma infecção na garganta.
sentences.en: In the morning, she took Letícia to the doctor, who said it was a throat infection.

sentences.pt: Durante a semana em que Letícia ficou doente, Juliana fez sopa todos os dias.
sentences.en: During the week Letícia was sick, Juliana made soup every day.

sentences.pt: Thiago, por sua vez, deixava chocolates embaixo da porta do quarto dela.
sentences.en: Thiago, in turn, left chocolates under her bedroom door.

sentences.pt: Aos poucos, Letícia percebeu que tinha sido muito chata com os dois.
sentences.en: Little by little, Letícia realized she had been very unpleasant to the two of them.

sentences.pt: Quando o pai voltou, encontrou os três rindo no sofá, vendo uma novela.
sentences.en: When her father came back, he found the three of them laughing on the sofa, watching a soap opera.

sentences.pt: Hoje Letícia ainda chama Juliana pelo nome, mas diz para as amigas que ganhou uma segunda mãe.
sentences.en: Today Letícia still calls Juliana by her name, but tells her friends that she gained a second mother.

sentences.pt: E Thiago, que antes era só o enteado do pai, agora ela chama de irmão.
sentences.en: And Thiago, who before was just her father's stepson, she now calls her brother.

sentences.pt: Mariana e Sofia são irmãs gêmeas, mas têm personalidades muito diferentes.
sentences.en: Mariana and Sofia are twin sisters, but they have very different personalities.

sentences.pt: Mariana é calma e quieta, enquanto Sofia é agitada e um pouco teimosa.
sentences.en: Mariana is calm and quiet, while Sofia is restless and a bit stubborn.

sentences.pt: No ano passado, o avô delas morreu e deixou como herança uma casa antiga numa cidade pequena de Minas Gerais.
sentences.en: Last year, their grandfather died and left an old house in a small town in Minas Gerais as an inheritance.

sentences.pt: A casa tinha sido construída pelo bisavô, um imigrante que chegou ao Brasil há quase cem anos.
sentences.en: The house had been built by their great-grandfather, an immigrant who arrived in Brazil almost a hundred years ago.

sentences.pt: Felipe, o marido de Mariana, é um empresário ambicioso.
sentences.en: Felipe, Mariana's husband, is an ambitious businessman.

sentences.pt: Ele achava que as irmãs deviam destruir a casa e construir um prédio no lugar.
sentences.en: He thought the sisters should tear down the house and build an apartment building in its place.

sentences.pt: "Daqui a cinco anos, vocês vão ganhar muito dinheiro com os apartamentos", dizia ele.
sentences.en: "Five years from now, you'll make a lot of money from the apartments," he would say.

sentences.pt: Sofia ficou com muita raiva e disse que nunca concordaria com isso.
sentences.en: Sofia got very angry and said she would never agree to that.

sentences.pt: Durante semanas, as duas irmãs quase não se falaram.
sentences.en: For weeks, the two sisters hardly spoke to each other.

sentences.pt: Em julho, a avó, que é viúva e tem oitenta e dois anos, pediu que as netas fossem com ela até a casa.
sentences.en: In July, their grandmother, who is a widow and is eighty-two, asked her granddaughters to go with her to the house.

sentences.pt: Ela queria arrumar o quarto do marido antes que as netas decidissem algo.
sentences.en: She wanted to tidy up her husband's room before her granddaughters decided anything.

sentences.pt: No quarto do avô, as gêmeas encontraram uma mala cheia de fotos e cadernos antigos.
sentences.en: In their grandfather's bedroom, the twins found a suitcase full of old photos and notebooks.

sentences.pt: As fotos mostravam festas, aniversários e almoços de domingo no jardim da casa.
sentences.en: The photos showed parties, birthdays and Sunday lunches in the garden of the house.

sentences.pt: Num dos cadernos, o bisavô contava como tinha plantado as árvores do jardim com os filhos.
sentences.en: In one of the notebooks, their great-grandfather told how he had planted the trees in the garden with his children.

sentences.pt: A avó chorou e contou histórias de antepassados que elas nunca tinham conhecido.
sentences.en: Their grandmother cried and told stories about ancestors they had never known.

sentences.pt: Naquela noite, Mariana ligou para o marido e explicou que não queria perder aquela história.
sentences.en: That night, Mariana called her husband and explained that she didn't want to lose that history.

sentences.pt: Felipe ficou em silêncio por alguns segundos.
sentences.en: Felipe was silent for a few seconds.

sentences.pt: Depois, admitiu que talvez a família precisasse mais da casa do que do dinheiro.
sentences.en: Then he admitted that maybe the family needed the house more than the money.

sentences.pt: Ele disse que eles podiam reformar a casa e passar ali as férias e os feriados da família.
sentences.en: He said they could renovate the house and spend family vacations and holidays there.

sentences.pt: Sofia, por sua vez, pediu desculpa à irmã por tudo que tinha dito.
sentences.en: Sofia, in turn, apologized to her sister for everything she had said.

sentences.pt: Neste ano, a reforma terminou, e a família toda passou as festas de fim de ano na casa do bisavô.
sentences.en: This year, the renovation was finished, and the whole family spent the end-of-year holidays at their great-grandfather's house.
